vertical_reference: LOLA radial height relative to lunar reference sphere; source lineage plus GeoTIFF CRS, independently checked against Horizons center radii and spherical shape at run time
longitude_convention: East-positive [0,360) in site properties, azimuth from geographic north clockwise
pixel_registration: Rasterio corner affine converted once to cell centre; GDAL AREA_OR_POINT retained
interpolation_method: Nearest valid DEM cell at each radial sample; circular linear horizon interpolation only across two fully covered adjacent bearings
near_radius_rule: Round down to 500 m below nearest footprint boundary minus 500 m, cap at 8000 m
near_seam_fallback: Follow the inset 5 m raster footprint per bearing if the fixed-radius near seam fails and both fallback validation phases meet the same limits
